name: sgs/form-review
title: SGS Form Review
description: Displays a summary of form fields for review before submission.

heading.label: Review heading
heading._note: Renders as <h3 class="sgs-form-review__heading"> — no per-instance colour/font-size/weight attribute exists on this block; the heading is styled entirely by shared framework CSS. clusters: [] is a genuine gap, not hidden.

intro.label: Intro text
intro._note:
Renders as

, a fixed hard-coded string (not a block attribute), styled entirely by shared framework CSS. clusters: [] is a genuine gap.

list.label: Review summary list
list._note: Renders as an empty <dl class="sgs-form-review__list"> — populated client-side by view.js with the submitted field rows. No per-instance style attribute exists on this block for the list or its rows; styling is shared framework CSS. clusters: [] is a genuine gap.
